column1: Districts, softening slightlyoverall. Auto sales receded modestly on average, after consumers had rushed to buy vehicles ear-lier this year to avoid tariffs. Tourism activity was mixed, manufacturing activity edged lower, andnonfinancial services activity was little changed on average but varied across Districts.
